lines.en: label bathhouse35p1:
scene iosenseifaint1
: ...and then Murakami hit a walk-off missile to the opposite field that smacked some old lady right in the face! It was totally crazy! You had to see it!
: Io, I don’t like baseball.
: Yeah, I know. But I do, so you should at least try to be interested. Like I do when you talk about other girls around me.
: But you never try to be interested when I talk about other girls.
: Sure I do! I just fail immediately.
As you can see, I’ve decided to spend the afternoon at the bathhouse...and by afternoon I mean “night” because the day has kind of just slipped away from me at this point.
But hey, I’ve apparently got decently high tolerance when it comes to hot water and don’t feel anywhere even close to passing out just yet despite being in here for-
: Io, how long have I been in here for?
scene iosenseifaint2
: Mmm......six hours. But you don’t have to rush to get out. The more time I get to spend with you, the better.
Strike that. I apparently have very high tolerance when it comes to hot water. But I make up for that in being utterly horrible when it comes to time management.
Either way, we wind up in the same position we’ve found ourselves in time and time before — with me facing one direction while Io faces the other.

I’m not quite sure what makes her immune to the allure of my penis (Especially given just how much she’s seen of it), but I’m pretty confident it’s only a matter of time now until she winds up in the bath with me.
And I’m dead set on spending another six hours in here if that brings me any closer to whatever rhetorical tipping point is needed to make that happen.
: Is it really okay if you just spend all of your time with me instead of watching the front desk?
Or at least I tell myself I’m dead set on that while my mouth attempts to betray me in coaxing her away.
But on the bright side, at least one segment of my being isn’t morally inept tonight.
: It’s fine. I put a sign thingy up. And it’s not like I’ve been completely neglecting my post. I’m still going out there to check on stuff every once in a while.
scene iosenseifaint3
: In fact, it’s probably better for business if I stay on the men’s side and make sure all of our male customers don’t go peeping on the women.
: I am the only male customer you ever have.
: And are you saying you wouldn’t try and look through the fence if I wasn’t around?
: Fair point.
: It would be nice to have something to look at while I’m in here, though.
scene iosenseifaint4
: Want me to go get your phone? There’s a level of damage-risk involved since you’re in the bath and whatnot, but I do it all the time and I’ve only lost, like...one phone because of it.
: I was suggesting something a bit more impure if you catch my drift.
scene iosenseifaint5
: Hey, it’s not my business what you look at on your phone. I was just trying to be of some help since I am technically on the clock right now.
: What about when you’re off the clock?
Somehow or another, I manage to remind my mouth of who we really are as the last, flimsy barrier between my good side and bad side is ripped to shreds.
: When I’m off the clock, I have to clean everything. Then, I have to eat dinner. Then, I have to pick up dinner for Uta. Then, I have to walk all the way back to the dorms.
: As you can see, I’ve got a pretty busy night ahead of me.
: Sounds to me like you could use a little something to relax.
: Probably. But I should wait at least another two hours before popping a second Adderall.
: If only there was some other way for you to wind down...
scene iosenseifaint6
: Want me to give you a few minutes alone so you can relieve yourself and stop trying to get me into the bath with you?
: Also, when I say “relieve yourself” I mean outside of the bath, please. That stuff’s not good for the drain.
: That’s probably for the best at this point. It’s a little difficult for me to stop myself once my brain gets locked onto something.
scene iosenseifaint7

: Testosterone will do that to you. I think. I’m admittedly less knowledgeable about the male anatomy than the female one. But that’s not something I want to get into with you, even if you are my teacher.
: Hold on. I’ll Google it.
: Io-
: Yup. Google says, “Sexual desire is typically higher in men than in women, with testosterone (T) thought to account for this difference.” The more you know.
: Io, how much longer are you going to do this for?
scene iosenseifaint8
: Do what? Google stuff? Because I’m already done. That was it.
: You know what I mean.
: Of course I know what you mean, which is why I’m trying to delicately steer the conversation away from that subject by both boring and annoying you with science and stats. Is it working?
: A little bit, yeah...
scene iosenseifaint9
: Great! Then you won’t mind if I just zoom right on past all this anatomy stuff and find something else to annoy you about!
: Ooh, here’s an article about whales. That should kill a few more minutes while we wait for all the women to leave.
I’m going to have to get to the bottom of this sooner or later...I’m just not sure how when every time I try winds up like this.
And even if Uta has trouble keeping her mouth shut, I know she won’t just go spilling whatever Io’s deal is to me if I ask nicely.
It’s obviously going to require a little more work...but how exactly can I work toward it when the tool I’ve used for every other issue thus far is disabled?
Sex has been my weapon for almost everything- but some creatures or targets require something a little different.
I don’t want to have to manipulate Io into revealing her secrets to me, especially when I know she’s perceptive enough to pick up on that immediately.
The saddest part of all of it is that this method probably would work-
And that she’d simply allow herself to be manipulated because it would make it easier to blame her mental shortcomings on someone else later on.
I know that to be true because that’s what I would do. And every day that passes by, she seems more and more similar to me.
But no one will ever be an exact replica...so there will always be something to misunderstand or misinterpret.
I just hope it won’t last forever.
Because beneath the sentimentality and the desire for her to feel safe whenever she’s with me-
There is an undying urge to shove my cock so deep inside of her that she splits into two pieces.
And an even greater urge to show her that what she wants isn’t what she wants at all.
: Ooooh, interesting. Sensei, did you know there’s a type of whale that-
scene iosenseifaint10
: Um...hello?...Is anyone there?...
: That’s not another guy, is it?
: I hope not. I don’t like sharing.
: Oh. No. That's a girl.
: Is she attractive?
: Not really.
: Screw it. Let her in anyway.
: Hey, you. You’re not allowed over here, you know. This is the men’s bath.
: Y-Yes! I know, but...the towel rack is empty and...I left mine at home...
scene iosenseifaint11
: Ugh, already? Just how busy are we on the other side tonight?
: Sensei, I’ll be back in a few minutes. Just gotta refill some stuff.
scene iosenseifaint12
: But remember, no jerking it in the bath.
: It’s bad for the drains, I know.
: Atta boy.
scene iosenseifaint13
: Hah...
I close my eyes and try to relax a bit as Io exits the men’s side of the bath.
I know I was getting ahead of myself a short while ago, but...I guess I’m just not used to getting the runaround when it comes to romance.
If you can even call this romance, that is.
If anything, it feels more like I’m her uncle sometimes — what with the minimal sexual attraction and the overall desire to just “hang out” with me.
But, then again, she has mentioned on many occasions having actual feelings for me and wanting to be my girlfriend...
All things considered, though...that’s pretty tame compared to my current perception of what unclehood entails.
I just wish I could bring myself to understand how she can love in such a “hands-off” kind of way.
For me, that’s not what love is like at all.
For me, love is something much more primitive.
And while that may be just me poorly defining one more word that’s meant to be interpreted in a different way, I-
I-
scene iosenseifaint14
scene iosenseifaint15
: Aaahh...
: There’s nothing quite like a hot bath after a long day of being dead.
scene iosenseifaint16
: Oh, hey.
: Come here often?
scene black
scene iosenseifaint17
: Ah...You’re finally awake.
: Where am I?...
scene iosenseifaint18
: My room.
: You passed out in the bath...which, in hindsight, is probably my fault after letting you stay in there for over six hours. So yeah, I’ll take the hit for this one.
: Do you...need anything? Water? Tea? Maybe like, a...sandwich or something?
: If there’s something specific you’re craving, it means your body’s probably low on some kind of nutrient or something. And there’s plenty of stuff downstairs I could grab for you.
: How long have I been out?
scene iosenseifaint19

: Not long. Maybe only twenty minutes or so. But I was somehow able to drag you up here all by myself, which I should definitely be praised for. Just...when you’re a little more conscious. I can wait until then.
I stare up at an unfamiliar ceiling, but instead of wondering what transpired between when I passed out and now, I get stuck guessing how many more times I’ll wake up here.
One if I’m lucky.
Two if Io is an idiot.
Three or more if there’s anything to this connection other than “obnoxious girl” and “the guy she latched onto.”
The room smells like her — a mix of blueberries and wood polish. It’s just as cluttered as her dorm and it appears as though it hasn’t been dusted or cleaned in over a year.
She probably doesn’t spend much time in here. And if I didn’t know her as well as I do, I might even mistake it for some sort of storage room.
But, with that being said...it’s far more comfortable than it has any right to be.
And I’m not quite sure if I’m just saying that because I’m waking up in a daze.
I stare at the ceiling again.
There’s a tennis ball grip on the pull-chain of a fan.
The word “Io” is written on it.
And this one small glimpse of one small speck of her childhood makes me sick to my stomach for the things I was thinking just a short while ago.
I’d give anything to not desire fruit before it’s at its ripest — and I curse this body’s need for the sourest of sweets.
: So...tea? Water? What’s it gonna be?
: You really carried me all the way up here by yourself?
scene iosenseifaint20
: I’m stronger than I look, Sensei.
: Though, I will reiterate that it was more like dragging you than carrying you. And if you feel sore tomorrow morning, blame the stairs, not me.
: Thank you, Io. I really appreciate that.
scene iosenseifaint21
: It’s nothing. Like I said, it’s probably my fault in the first place.
: Oh, and I couldn’t get your pants back on without getting a little too handsy, so I hope you don’t mind what I dressed you up in instead.
scene iosenseifaint22
: What have you done to me?
: What? I think you look kinda cute in this. It’s a side of you I’m sure that only I’ve gotten to see, and that makes me really happy.
scene iosenseifaint23
: Why do you even own something like this?
: It’s my aunt’s, obviously. She’s not really known for her sense of fashion. And I’m not really known for wearing flashy colors or leopard print.
: Neither am I. Where are my normal clothes?
: Folded near the door. But you don’t need to worry about getting changed right now. Let me take care of you a little bit longer. Just until you’re ready to go home.
: Heck, you don’t even have to go home today if you don’t want. My aunt’s away for the whole weekend and I’ve got the place to myself.
: And you’re sure this is okay?
: Of course. If I’m gonna treat anybody to the ultimate Io special at no charge at all, it’s you.
scene iosenseifaint24
: Wow, you must really be out of it. I basically just handed you the perfect opportunity for another perverted joke and you completely squandered-
: I’m sorry for saying all that stuff to you earlier, Io.
scene iosenseifaint25
: I know it makes you uncomfortable, but I keep doing it anyway.
: You don’t deserve that.
scene iosenseifaint26
: Even...
: Even if that’s true, it’s not something you need to apologize for.
: There’s no reason you should have to change the way you are just because I’ve got issues. That’s not fair to anybody.
: What’s not fair is that you have to go so far out of your way for me for things like this, but I never do anything for you.
scene iosenseifaint27
: Now, that’s not true at all.
: You brought me into your class when I wasn’t happy in my last one.
: You let me bother you all the time even though I know it annoys you and you’ve miraculously not asked me to stop talking to you yet.
: You even chased me out of the bathhouse when I got upset about my trashy toy and held my hand in the park.
: I’m not the only one who does stuff for you, Sensei. In fact, this is nothing compared to everything you’ve done for me and-
: And what?
scene iosenseifaint28
: Pfft!
: ...And what?
: Hahaha! Hahahahaha!
: I’m sorry! I can’t do it! I tried, but I just can’t! It’s not possible to have a serious conversation with you while you’re dressed like that! Hahah! Hahahahaha!
scene iosenseifaint29
: Okay, okay. Let me try this-
scene iosenseifaint30
: Hahahaha! Ahahaha! Hahah! Ahh! Oh god! I can’t do it! I can’t!
: Hah...
: You said my clothes are near the door?
scene black
: Hahah! Hahah...ahh...Yeah...Hahaha...If you want to keep talking, go ahead and put them on.
: Either that or I can keep them as a keepsake of yours and you can keep my aunt’s clothes as a keepsake of- oh. The pants are already off.
: This is not a memory I want to treasure and I’d prefer if we never talked about this-
scene iosenseifaint31
: Io! I came as quickly as I could! Is Sensei really-
scene iosenseifaint32
: Hey, Uta. He’s awake now. You don’t have to worry anymore.
scene iosenseifaint33
: Uta?
scene iosenseifaint34
: Welp. Uta's dead now.
: That was quick.
: Rest in peace...my dearest friend.
scene black
